class View:
    def __init__(self):
        self.rows=[]; self.notes={}; self.loading=False; self.error=None; self.seq=0; self.latest_request=None; self.acked_latest=False
    def begin(self, query):
        self.seq+=1
        request_id = self.seq
        self.latest_request = request_id
        self.loading = True
        self.error = None
        self.acked_latest = False
        return request_id
    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        if request_id != self.latest_request:
            return False
        if self.acked_latest:
            return False
        self.loading = False
        self.error = None
        self.rows = list(rows) if rows is not None else []
        self.acked_latest = True
        return True

import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("view", "view.py")
view = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(view)

def make():
    v = view.View()
    return v

def test_monotonic_ids():
    v = make()
    ids = [v.begin("q") for _ in range(5)]
    assert ids == [1,2,3,4,5], ids

def test_old_id_rejected():
    v = make()
    latest = v.begin("q1")
    old = v.begin("q2")
    assert v.finish(latest, [1]) == True
    assert v.rows == [1]
    assert v.finish(old, [99]) == False
    assert v.rows == [1]

def test_duplicate_rejected():
    v = make()
    rid = v.begin("q")
    assert v.finish(rid, [1]) == True
    assert v.finish(rid, [2]) == False
    assert v.rows == [1]

def test_rows_copied():
    v = make()
    rid = v.begin("q")
    rows = [["a","b"], 1]
    assert v.finish(rid, rows) == True
    rows[0][0] = "mutated"
    assert v.rows == [["a","b"], 1]

def test_begin_keeps_rows_and_clears_error():
    v = make()
    v.error = "boom"
    v.rows = ["old"]
    latest = v.begin("q1")
    old = v.begin("q2")
    assert v.error is None
    assert v.rows == ["old"]
    assert v.finish(old, ["x"]) == False
    assert v.rows == ["old"]
    assert v.finish(latest, ["new"]) == True
    assert v.rows == ["new"]

def test_loading_bool():
    v = make()
    assert v.loading == False
    v.begin("q")
    assert v.loading == True
    v.finish(1, [1])
    assert v.loading == False

def test_notes_preserved():
    v = make()
    v.notes = {1: "job one"}
    v.begin("q1")
    v.begin("q2")
    assert v.notes == {1: "job one"}
    assert v.finish(2, [1]) == True
    assert v.notes == {1: "job one"}
    assert v.finish(2, [2]) == False

def test_none_rows_accepted():
    v = make()
    rid = v.begin("q")
    assert v.finish(rid, None) == True
    assert v.rows == []

test_monotonic_ids()
test_old_id_rejected()
test_duplicate_rejected()
test_rows_copied()
test_begin_keeps_rows_and_clears_error()
test_loading_bool()
test_notes_preserved()
test_none_rows_accepted()
print("all tests passed")
